label: batch-26
tail:
Batch 26 Step-1 is now fully closed. Summary of what was verified and completed:

## Verification of the inherited state
I re-read the binding owner direction, the batch notes, all 12 item carriers, the manifest, coverage, proof contract and cross-batch inputs, and independently spot-checked the mathematics (including recomputing the equilateral-triangle inertia, the parallel-axis shift, the Euler-pole derivative rank, and the degenerate line-mass spectrum). I also read the batch-9 suppliers and confirmed with explicit counterexamples that the recorded escalation is accurate: `lem-cm-inertia-matrix-properties` clause 3/step 4.1 and `cor-cm-principal-axes-of-the-inertia-matrix` clause 3/steps 4.1/5.1 do state inverted positivity/vanishing criteria; batch 26 consumes only their correct clauses, and `pthm-cm10-principal-axes` proves the correct criteria locally.

## Repair made before recording
While re-verifying, I found and repaired a genuine notation overload in the frame-change passages of three items (`post-cm10-rigid-material` clause (v), `def-cm10-rigid-body-configuration` clause (d), and the statement + proof of `pthm-cm10-frame-covariance`): primes denoted both second-frame description maps and time derivatives (step 2.1, read with the clause-1 convention, was literally inconsistent), and `R`/`v` denoted both frame-change rotation/boost and the orientation path/material velocity field. The fix changes no claim, dependency, clause or step count: second-frame description quantities are now tilded, the frame rotation/boost are written `Q`/`u` with an explicit note that they are the parameters written `R`/`v` in `post-cm01-frames`, and primes mean derivatives throughout. The manifest statements and the theorem's proof-contract derivations (all eight steps + boundary evidence) were synchronized to the repaired text.

## Readiness records and final checks (all re-run on the final carriers)
- `step1-decisions record`: **12/12 items `ready`** (owner false, exact frontmatter `deps` + evidence); `check --run` now reports **0 remaining cm10 rows**.
- `precheck` **8 checked, 0 failing**; `proof-layout` **12 items, 49 steps, 0 defects**; `rendercheck` **14 files clean**.
- `proof-contract --strict` **12/12, 0 errors/0 warnings**; `proof-contract-coverage` (overlay) **7/7 covered**; contract claims match item step text exactly.
- `content-policy` **0/0**; `manifest-deps` **0 errors**; `manifest-integrity` **no scope drift**; `validate-plan` no cm10 finding; `coverage-checklist` **0/0**; `source-fetch-check` **9/9 fetch-verified**; `item-dependency-levels` run-wide **0 cm10 findings** (focused replay declared = computed); `depcheck`/`fwdcheck`/`extcheck`/`pathcheck`/`citecheck` no cm10-attributable findings; scoped `validatePhysicsContent` replay **0 errors, 12 items**; `frontier-dependency-ledger refresh` clean with 0 orphaned cm10 rows.
- Batch notes updated with the notation-repair record, actual check outputs, and the open findings (batch-9 supplier defect escalation; run-level mathematics-import drift in `items/def-finite-sum.md`; other batches' empty scaffold inventories; plan-spec requires annotation).

Step 1 initial authoring evidence is complete; the carrier set is `research/physics-cm-qm-gr-79-2026-10-11-batch-26.{pages,coverage,proof-contracts,cross-batch-dependencies,notes}` plus the 12 items and 2 page carriers, with independent review following in Step 2.
